independent_units: Canonical cantilever specimen: remove documented repeat prefix 2_ and suffix -2; keep repeat tests together. One source wafer/manufacturing campaign does not establish batch generalization.
limitations: Curator-only acquisitions contain historically exposed responses; discovery workers must not access source root or complete native traces
Stored reported Pb2 is not independently recovered or validated as a fracture event from native traces
No test targets are exported; no evaluator vault accessed
Native acquisitions total more than 10 MB; only compact public geometry/task tables and lineage are candidates for release
Scientific admission, redistribution notices and physical independence remain review gates

policy.measurements: Stored summary cells A identity, B/C/D/E/I geometry and G author-reported Pb2. Read unit headers. Ignore all source fitted corrections, toughness and response-derived columns.
policy.native_decoding: Decode each exactly matched PI 89 raw trace: depth nm, load uN, time s, depth V, load V; cp1252 micro sign; validate declared point count, finite values and strictly increasing acquisition clock
policy.native_scope: Trace arrays are curator-only. Do not export trace values as predictive inputs or identify Pb2 by a naive maximum.
policy.split: Inherited original confirmation predicate; development groups sorted by canonical SHA256([compact-v2, case, opaque group]); first max(2,floor(n/5)) dev. Assignments explicit.
policy.timing: SEM geometry may be measured after test; retrospective geometry-conditioned response only

reference_parser_provenance.reuse: Summary measurement/identity specification independently implemented and expanded with raw trace decoding; no reference equations, fitted state or evaluator copied
